what.text: Internal displacement occurs inside the Abyei area due to conflict, violence, and disasters.
By the end of 2025, 57756 people were living in internal displacement inside the Abyei area because of conflict and violence.
In addition, 26000 people were still displaced by disasters inside the Abyei area at the end of 2019.

why.text: Displacement in the region is driven by conflict and violence as well as natural hazards.
Floods are the specific disaster hazard recorded as causing displacement in the area.
The sources do not provide details on specific conflict events or armed opposition groups.

when.text: Main displacement waves occurred in 2015 and between 2022 and 2025.
At the end of 2015, the count of people living in internal displacement from conflict reached 82000.
During 2022, IDMC reported 55750 new displacement movements caused by conflict and violence.

how.text: The sources do not detail specific travel routes or living conditions for displaced populations.
Conflict displacement data measures people living in internal displacement inside the Abyei area at the end of each year.
New displacement data counts the number of movement events during the year rather than the number of displaced individuals.
